name: task-tracker
description: This branch supplies the backend, PostgreSQL schema, Docker Compose setup, unit tests and integration tests for SWE4-10, SWE4-12 and SWE4-13. It does not configure GitHub Actions, public server access, monitoring or Playwright. The home page is an integration placeholder; Isuri will build the task interface in `app/templates/index.html` and can put browser assets in `app/static/`.
